manage.makeLeaderConfirm: Hand leadership to {{name}}? You will keep your current rank and lose all leader rights.
manage.disbandHelp: Disbanding removes every member, rank and chat room. Any treasury is split evenly among the members (remainder to you), open loans are written off, and no war may be in progress. To step down instead, make another member leader from the Members tab.
manage.disbandConfirm: This cannot be undone. Every member is removed from {{name}}, the treasury is split evenly among them and open loans are written off.
manage.leaveHelp: You will lose access to the treasury, the war room and alliance chat.

artwork.title: Alliance artwork
artwork.help: Choose a photo and banner for your alliance. Changes are published together when you save.
artwork.photoHelp: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP. Up to 4 MB and 1024 × 1024 pixels.
artwork.bannerHelp: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP. Up to 4 MB and 2400 × 1200 pixels; a wide image works best.
artwork.saveError: Could not save artwork. Check the image dimensions and try again.
artwork.tooLarge: Choose an image smaller than 4 MB.
artwork.frameHelp: Drag the image to reposition it, then adjust the crop with the sliders. The original image is preserved.
artwork.keyboardHelp: Focus the preview and use arrow keys to shift the image; + and − zoom. Sliders also support the keyboard.
artwork.imageError: The image could not be loaded. Close this editor and choose another image.

reserved.title: {{name}} is reserved
reserved.visitor: A new era began, so this alliance is on hold until its leader reactivates it.
reserved.member: A new era began, so your alliance is on hold. Its name, roster, ranks and artwork are kept. Its treasury, loans, troop contracts and wars belonged to the old era and were closed.
reserved.stillOpen: Still available: viewing the roster and ranks, managing ranks, removing members, transferring leadership, and leaving the alliance at any time without the leader.
reserved.closed: Closed until reactivated: treasury and loans, troop contracts and dues, wars, diplomacy, target lists, shared intel, announcements, alliance chat, recruiting and premium perks.
reserved.requirementsIntro: The leader reactivates the alliance in the new era by reaching level {{level}} and paying {{cost}} gold.
reserved.waitingForLeader: Only {{leader}} can reactivate the alliance. You can wait, or leave.
reserved.confirmBody: This spends {{cost}} gold from your hand. Alliance features reopen for everyone.
reserved.alreadyActive: The alliance was already active; nothing was charged.
reserved.leaveHint: You can leave at any time; the leader does not need to reactivate first.

upgrades.title: Alliance Hall
upgrades.intro: Upgrade the Alliance Hall with treasury gold to hold more members, let each member deposit more often and raise how much the treasury can hold. Levels are bought one at a time by the leader or a rank with "Buy upgrades".
upgrades.blockReserved: The alliance is reserved until the leader reactivates it.
upgrades.blockPermission: Only the leader or a rank with "Buy upgrades" can buy.
upgrades.footnote: The cost is paid from the treasury. Deposits are counted per member over the last 24 hours. Only deposits are held to the treasury cap; loan repayments and dues still arrive. Alliances above a member cap keep their members but cannot add more. A new era returns the hall to Camp.
upgrades.maxed: The Alliance Hall is at its highest level.
upgrades.confirmMessage: Upgrade to {{name}} (level {{level}}) for {{cost}} gold from the treasury?
upgrades.loadError: Failed to load the Alliance Hall.

memberDues.title: Fee and dues
memberDues.loadError: Could not load the fee and dues.
memberDues.leaderExempt: As leader you pay no dues.
memberDues.arrearsHelp: Unpaid dues are taken first at the next collection. Pay them now from your gold on hand.
memberDues.payInvalid: Enter at least 1 and no more than you owe.
memberDues.whereSetter: You set the fee and dues in
memberDues.whereMember: The leader, or a rank with "Set join fee and dues", changes them on the Settings tab.
memberDues.settingsHelp: New members pay the join fee once from their gold on hand. Dues are taken from every member except the leader at each period start (00:00 OT; weeks start Monday, months on the 1st). A member who cannot pay in full pays what they have and owes the rest; nobody is removed for unpaid dues.
memberDues.choosePeriod: Choose how often to collect first
memberDues.settingsFootnote: A new fee only applies to players who join afterwards. New dues start at the next period start; members are never charged for time before they joined. Fees and dues go to the treasury even above the Alliance Hall treasury cap.
memberDues.confirmFee: Joining {{name}} costs a join fee of {{fee}}, taken from your gold on hand.
memberDues.confirmDues: Members pay dues of {{dues}} from gold on hand; what you cannot pay is owed until you pay it.
memberDues.confirmRequestNote: For a join request the fee is taken when the request is accepted, at the fee in force then.
memberDues.acceptFeeNote: Accepting a request takes the {{fee}} join fee from the applicant's gold on hand; a player who cannot pay stays pending.
